scope: Engine long block and attached fuel, induction, exhaust, ignition, lubrication, cooling and crankshaft interfaces. Vehicle-side tanks, radiator, battery and transmission internals belong to later truck systems.
count_policy: Modeled occurrence count is not a completion percentage. This is a work breakdown, not a verified physical bill of materials.
gates: Resolve installed component variants and physical decomposition against applicable references
Reconcile dimensions and interfaces at a common datum; label every remaining assumption
Represent each identified physical component separately, including seals and retaining hardware
Verify hierarchy, scale, solid validity, interfaces and relevant motion
Provide per-part explanations, source links and system-level operating/diagnostic context
